content.title: Allegiant to Buy Sun Country in Deal Valued at $1.5 Billion
content.summary: Sun Country’s shareholders will receive 0.1557 shares of Allegiant common stock and $4.10 in cash per Sun Country share, the companies said Sunday.  The offer is about 20% above Sun Country’s closing share price Friday, according to a release.  Shares in Sun Country rose as much as 18% to $18.54 in premarket trading Monday, while Allegiant was little changed.
